trust_decision.summary: Whether a route rule (including an `appMiddleware` auth gate) applies to a request is decided by matching the request path against route-rule keys with the same case rule as vue-router (case-insensitive unless `router.options.sensitive`); the rule keys are added verbatim to the rou3 routers in `getRouteRulesRouter` while only the lookup path is folded, so a mixed-case key never matches.

landing_point.why: The summary names `appMiddleware` auth gates, and every app-side consumer (global route-rules middleware, both routers, `<NuxtLayout>`, payload composables) funnels through `getRouteRules`, which line 74 already lowercases the lookup path for — the obvious suspect site, while the actual cause is the unfolded keys in the matcher built at packages/nitro-server/src/index.ts:351.

fix_sites.entry_point: build-time route-rules matcher `#build/route-rules.mjs`, consumed by the public `getRouteRules()` composable and `<NuxtLayout>`
compiled route-rules template (`addTemplate` 'route-rules.mjs') emitted into the app bundle
`nuxt build`/`nuxt generate` app manifest `prerendered` list, read by `getAppManifest()`/`isPrerendered()`
public `getRouteRules()` composable (http render / client navigation / module code)
`nuxt build`/`nuxt generate` prerender page injection (pages module `nitro:build:before`)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: That block is build-time only and decides which pages get prerendered (a `prerender` optimisation) rather than the request-time `appMiddleware` auth gate the advisory describes, and it builds its own rou3 router in the pages module instead of using the route-rules matcher, so it looks like another team's concern.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Case-sensitive routing: with `router.options.sensitive: true` (supported in config and via `app/router.options.ts`) route-rule keys must stay verbatim and keys that differ only in case (`/Admin/Dashboard` vs `/admin/dashboard`) must remain distinct rules; a blanket lowercase of keys and paths breaks both and also silently collapses colliding keys.

O6_input_shapes: lookup path in any casing (upper, lower, mixed) for the same route
`router.options.sensitive: true` (verbatim keys, no folding) vs default insensitive routing
all three `getRouteRules()` argument shapes: H3Event, `{ path }`, deprecated bare string

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Server-side application of the same route-rule keys (ssr:false, cache/isr, noScripts, prerender and Nitro redirects) goes through Nitro's own route-rules matcher, which is fed the same verbatim keys; the Nuxt route-rules middleware deliberately returns early on the server, so mixed-case keys still miss server-side after the published fix.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: That is Nitro's own route-rules implementation inside a dependency, not Nuxt's compiled app matcher; server rendering and redirects are Nitro's responsibility, so the advisory's Nuxt-side fix need not cover it.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (nitro-server runtime handler) plus an external dependency not vendored in this tree

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Prerendered-URL identity in the app manifest is compared with exact string equality, so a mixed-case route prerendered at `/Admin/Dashboard` is treated as not prerendered when served at `/admin/dashboard`, even though route-rule matching folds.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The manifest holds concrete prerendered URLs, not route-rule keys, so it is not route-rule matching and the advisory's folding property does not obviously extend to it.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, one file away from `getRouteRules`

O8b_injection_room.sibling: payload route-rule derivation that builds `<_payload.json>` keys from rule keys
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It consumes exactly the same rule keys in the same file as the matcher, so a maintainer fixing key casing would naturally add a second normalisation here (and it must agree with the folded matcher).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: redirect stub routes synthesised from route-rule keys for the client router
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Another consumer of rule keys in the pages module with its own glob-to-route conversion; a maintainer adding case handling would plausibly extend it there.
Page file casing flows straight into Nitro's route patterns here, the same producer path that yields mixed-case page-level rules.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: case-folded comparison of the manifest prerendered URL list
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It sits next to the route-rules lookups in the same composable and already assumes the same URL identity, so a maintainer could have written a folded variant.

O9_family: case-sensitivity handling / route-rule key normalisation leading to authorization bypass (CWE-178, CWE-863)

O10_build.project_tests: test/nuxt/composables.test.ts ('compiled route rules' + 'matches case-insensitively to mirror vue-router defaults'), packages/nuxt/test/route-rules.test.ts, and the 'route rules' block in test/basic.test.ts (playwright e2e); run needs `pnpm test:prepare` after install

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Lowercase the keys with a blanket `route.toLowerCase()` where the runtime matcher is compiled, which fixes `getRouteRules` but leaves the two build-time rou3 routers (prerender manifest and pages-module prerender injection) unfolded and breaks `router.options.sensitive`.
